## Type

- [ ] `feat` new behaviour
- [ ] `fix` bug fix
- [ ] `docs` / `design` documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` tooling or repo structure
- [ ] `release` version bump

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests in the matching `tests/<area>/` folder
- [ ] No new permissions, remote code, `eval`, or `new Function`
- [ ] Tested as an unpacked extension in Chrome (for UI or runtime changes)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (for user-facing changes)
